description: Vector Bat Mobile App - High realism 3D batsman visualizer, Grok/Gemini AI shot prediction, and offline sensor management

userStories.title: Procedural PBR textures & realistic proportions for 3D Batsman
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want realistic 3D visuals of the batsman and bat so the app feels like a professional coaching tool rather than a cartoon.
acceptanceCriteria: Batsman model uses canvas-generated PBR textures for willow bat, jersey, batting pads, and helmet
Renderer uses ACESFilmicToneMapping with realistic lighting and soft shadows
Bat blade is accurately sized (cricket standard proportions) with realistic grip and cone handle
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented in LiveSwingVisualizer.tsx with Three.js r134 canvas PBR textures and bent-knee athletic stance.

userStories.title: Real-time AI Shot Prediction with Grok & Gemini APIs
userStories.description: As a user, I want instant AI feedback predicting the shot type and quality after each real swing.
acceptanceCriteria: AiShotPredictionService integrates Grok beta API with Gemini 1.5 Flash fallback
Local physics heuristic fallback runs if network or APIs fail
Live screen displays AI Coach prediction with provider badge (GROK / GEMINI)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created services/AiShotPredictionService.ts and wired into HardwareSensorService.ts and live.tsx.

userStories.title: Strict offline sensor mode without hardcoded mock data
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to show OFFLINE when the sensor is disconnected rather than showing synthetic swing data.
acceptanceCriteria: Live screen displays OFFLINE badge when hardware WebSocket is disconnected
Metrics show '--' or 0 instead of fake mock values when disconnected
Stream source defaults to 'hardware' by default
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Updated live.tsx to initialize lastSwing to null and show OFFLINE badge.

userStories.title: Fixed timestep animation loop (rAF) in LiveSwingVisualizer
userStories.description: As a user, I want ultra-smooth 60fps swing physics and impact interpolation regardless of device refresh rate.
acceptanceCriteria: Visualizer animate loop uses fixed-timestep physics updates (accumulator pattern at 60Hz)
Bat rotation smoothly interpolates sensor quaternion/Euler angles
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Refactored visualizer animate() loop into 60Hz fixed-timestep physicsStep(dt) accumulator pattern.

userStories.title: Post-impact trajectory trail and sweet spot impact indicator
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want to see the 3D bat trajectory arc and a visual indicator where the ball struck the bat face.
acceptanceCriteria: Render 3D ribbon/line trail tracing the bat sweet spot during the swing
Show a glowing impact spot on the bat face where impact was registered
Trail automatically fades after swing resets
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 3D aerodynamic ribbon trail with vertex colors and radial shockwave sweet spot impact FX on bat face. Fixed camera framing for mobile portrait view and rescaled batsman to natural 1.0 proportions.

userStories.title: Textbook Side-On Biomechanical Batsman Stance & Anatomical Proportions
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want the 3D batsman to adopt an authentic side-on batting stance with realistic anatomical details (protective glove finger rolls, 7-cane pads, pro helmet grille) so the posture accurately reflects professional cricket technique.
acceptanceCriteria: Batsman adopts authentic side-on stance (chest facing off-side, front shoulder pointed down pitch, head turned over shoulder looking at bowler)
Batting gloves have segmented finger rolls and two-handed 'V' grip on bat handle
Pads feature 7 vertical cane ribs, knee roll wings, and top hat ankle wraps
Camera angles correspond accurately to cricket broadcast positions (side-on cover/point, bowler's end, keeper POV, overhead)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented textbook side-on athletic cricket stance, pro batting gloves with segmented finger rolls, 7-cane bolster pads with knee wings, StemGuard helmet with titanium grille, and broadcast camera positions.

userStories.title: Realistic Stadium Pitch, Radial Mown Grass Outfield & Atmospheric Stadium Lighting
userStories.description: As a user, I want the visualizer stage to resemble a real cricket stadium under floodlights with realistic turf, crease wear, chalk lines, and lighting ambience.
acceptanceCriteria: Outfield rendered with realistic alternating lawn mowing stripes and turf texture
Pitch features popping crease, return crease, bowling crease, and worn batting scuff patches
Atmospheric lighting with realistic floodlight glare, soft contact shadows, and tone mapping
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Created procedural clay-straw pitch texture with batsman footmark scuffs, radial mown grass outfield with grass flecks, 4 floodlight towers with halo flares, and boundary ring.

userStories.title: Kinematic Stroke Animations & Full-Body Weight Transfer
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want realistic stroke animations where the batsman strides into drives, pulls with rotational hip drive, and plays authentic forward defensive strokes.
acceptanceCriteria: Stroke animations include coordinated leg stride, torso rotation, and elbow lead
Hands and bat stay connected throughout the swing stroke trajectory
Bat speed and trajectory ribbon accurately represent stroke mechanics
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Aligned swing stroke kinematics to textbook cricket mechanics with dynamic hands, arms, body lean, and color-coded aerodynamic trajectory trails.

userStories.title: Anatomical 2-Handed Glove Grip & Dynamic Forearm/Elbow Kinematics
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want the batsman's hands to grip the bat naturally with textbook top-hand and bottom-hand positioning and articulated forearms/elbows that stay pinned to the handle throughout the swing.
acceptanceCriteria: Top (left) hand wraps firmly around upper handle with knuckles aligned towards off-side/cover
Bottom (right) hand holds lower handle with 'V' between thumb and index finger aligned down bat spine
Batting gloves feature distinct segmented finger sausage rolls, reinforced thumb guards, and leather palm wrap around rubber grip
Forearms and elbows dynamically track glove positions on the handle throughout all swing phases so wrists never disconnect or stretch unnaturally
High leading elbow posture maintained during backlift and drive downswing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented 3D pro batting gloves with segmented sausage finger rolls, Pittards leather palm, towel cuffs with pull-tabs, and continuous 2-bone arm IK locking forearms and elbows to handle.

userStories.title: Authentic Cricket Biomechanics: Footwork, Weight Transfer & Knee Flexion
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want realistic cricket footwork with front-knee flexion and rear heel lift on drives, and back-foot pivot and torso swivel on pull/cut shots.
acceptanceCriteria: Front-Foot Drives (Cover, Straight, On Drive, Defence): Front leg strides forward with 45° bent knee over popping crease; rear foot rises onto toe with heel lifted off turf
Back-Foot Strokes (Pull Shot, Square Cut): Weight transfers back onto flexed rear knee; torso swivels on ball of rear foot; front leg acts as stabilizing pivot
Spiked cricket boots remain grounded on turf surface without clipping or floating
Natural hip tilt, torso spine angle, and shoulder alignment coordinated with swing phase
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Head-Over-Ball Balance, Level Eyes & Willow Presentation Accuracy
userStories.description: As a cricketer, I want the batsman to maintain a still head over the contact point with level eyes, presenting the full face of the willow blade squarely to the ball.
acceptanceCriteria: Head remains rock-still with level horizontal eye-line focused down pitch at incoming ball throughout stroke
Bat comes down smoothly on line from 2nd slip corridor, presenting full face of the willow blade to the ball at impact
Wrist roll-over at contact for grounded drives; iconic high follow-through showing maker's decal to bowler
Ball impact synchronization: willow crack audio and radial shockwave trigger precisely when sweet spot reaches front pad line
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Anatomical Human Musculature, Jersey Cloth Shading & Equipment Polish
userStories.description: As a user, I want the 3D cricketer to have natural athletic proportions, shoulder deltoids, thigh guard contours, and realistic test match cricket whites fabric shading.
acceptanceCriteria: Anatomical shoulder deltoids, defined neck, chest taper, and thigh guard contour under cricket trousers
PBR fabric roughness and subtle creases on white cricket test jersey and trousers
High-definition English willow grain, cane spring handle laminations, and embossed holographic decals
Typecheck passes
